title: Hammer
description: Fair & Customizable TPA Mod for Fabric servers
body: ## what do? hammer is a ~~bloated multi-functional~~ (not yet :p) fabric server-side mod because there isn't enough server-side fabric mods for survival servers and "fair play" systems for functions like tpa. basically i made it for tpa and will eventually add other stuff too :D this mod requires [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) and the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)! ## /tpa and family the difference between other TPA mods is the restrictions that is placed within it. for example, after a death, you cannot for (by default) 12 hours initate a tpa request, or be teleported via tpa within a (by default) 100 block radius of your death. this blocks the cycle of tpa-ing back into a pvp fight after dying, or tpa-ing to your teammate after dying in a cave due to a warden or something, instead forcing you to go back manually to lift this restriction. another implemented restriction is that you cannot (by default) tpa to the overworld from the end and nether, but you can go to the end and nether from the overworld. this is completely customizable and even supports custom dimensions. ## /back this depends on the tpa system and works quite differently than normal `/back` seen in other plugins or mods. instead of being able to return to a death, you can only teleport to the original location you initated a `/tpa` to, or a `/tpahere` from another player, and only the most recent one. example usecase is to `/tpa` to a player's base to trade with them and using `/back` to quickly go back. soon you can also use it like other off-the-shelf `/back` plugins if you wish (a common example being the EssentialsX series of plugins) `/back` and `/tpa` behaviour can be turned off completely, or modified to your liking in the config file stored in `(mcserver path)/config/hammer.json` ## command list as of latest version ### core commands * `/hammer` - Hammer * `/hammer docs` - Hammer documentation ([https://hammer.loxodrome.app](https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fhammer.loxodrome.app)) * `/hammer reload` - **[OP and higher only]** reload hammer with config file changes ### teleportation commands * `/tpa [user]` - send a teleporation request to a player to their location * `/tpahere [user1/all] [user2] [...]` - send a teleportation request to a player/players to your location * `/tpaccept` or `/tpok` - accept a teleportation request * `/tpdeny` or `/tpno` - deny a teleportation request * `/tpalist` - tpa requests you've made and recieved * `/tpacancel` - cancel an outgoing tpa request * `/tpatoggle` - block tpa requests, or enable them back * `/back` - teleport back to your last location via `/tpa` --- ## license GPL 3.0 or later
